DIAGNOSIS READY: Major Depressive Disorder with Psychotic Features.

The combination of a 4-month history of persistent sadness, sleep/appetite disturbances, concentration issues, and mood-congruent auditory hallucinations strongly indicates a depressive disorder with psychotic features rather than migraines or primary psychotic disorders.
